business_problem: IGT Solutions needed to replace manual, error-prone workflows and a split relational-plus-vector architecture with a flexible platform that could store large volumes of operational and vector data, support multiple AI services across clouds, and shorten time to market for new client solutions.
solution_summary: IGT Solutions standardized many of its AI offerings on MongoDB Atlas so it could combine operational and vector data for travel, hospitality, procurement, recruitment, and other outsourced-service workloads. In the initial project that convinced the team, Atlas stored about 50 gigabytes of data and processed an average of 7 million tickets a day, while MongoDB Atlas Vector Search let the company build intelligent applications over structured and unstructured content without a separate vector store. Running on Azure with Python back-end services, MongoDB also collects operational logs and supports reporting, alerting, compliance, and multi-LLM integrations inside one multi-cloud platform. That common data layer powers solutions such as Procurement.AI and Recruitment.AI, where LLM workflows analyze thousands of resumés, answer finance queries, and schedule interviews, while developers can change schemas and add new AI services with minimal code changes.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores operational and application data for IGT's growing portfolio of AI solutions.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Adds vector retrieval so IGT can build intelligent applications over documents and other unstructured content.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud environment IGT uses with Python back-end services for many GenAI workloads.

data_flow: Operational records, tickets, documents, logs, and resumés are stored in MongoDB Atlas, retrieved through MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and fed into LLM-driven applications on Azure and Python back ends for search, query answering, reporting, and automated workflow execution.
business_outcome: MongoDB helped IGT Solutions raise productivity by 20%, improve time to market by 25%, cut finance-query response times by 90% for one client, and scale AI-assisted recruitment workflows that have already handled around 45,000 resumés.
